run_marching_cubes_naive: run the naive marching cubes algorithm on a 3D volume tensor to extract mesh vertices and faces
run_marching_cubes_extension: run the CUDA extension marching cubes algorithm on a 3D volume tensor to extract mesh vertices and faces
test_cube_configurations: test all 15 single cube vertex configurations against expected marching cubes output for cases 0 through 14
test_marching_cubes_shapes: test marching cubes extraction on single point, cube, sphere, and ball volume shapes
convert_vertex_coords_to_local: convert mesh vertex coordinates from grid space to normalized local coordinates in the range negative one to one
